name: Arduino Leonardo
description: Uno-shaped 5 V board whose ATmega32U4 has native USB, so it can act as a keyboard, mouse or MIDI device without extra chips.
notes: Native USB HID/CDC on the ATmega32U4; no ATmega16U2, so the serial port disappears while the sketch resets USB.
12 analog inputs: A0-A5 plus A6-A11 shared with D4, D6, D8, D9, D10, D12; SDA/SCL also have dedicated header pins.
Only 32 KB flash (4 KB bootloader) and 2.5 KB RAM; Micro-USB.
